reason: The preregistered mathematical map agrees with Algorithm 1 of arXiv:2305.10803v2, but several numerical definitions were not unique enough to implement without post-input discretion. This amendment resolves only those definitions before an S4 input is materialized; it does not change the candidate family, development strata, budgets, advancement gates or claim boundary.

resolved_ambiguities.finding: A gap ratio alone can label a regular but ill-conditioned close root as singular, and the preregistered rank_roundoff_multiplier otherwise had no defined use.
resolved_ambiguities.resolution: Use the frozen roundoff-scaled retained-value cutoff and deterministic smallest qualifying index below. A full-rank split is ineligible, and the separate final null-decay gate rejects a persistent discarded singular value.

resolved_ambiguities.finding: The mixed-direction exponent was frozen but the absolute scaling and reserve stencil were not.
resolved_ambiguities.resolution: Use the normalized-direction four-corner stencil and the two frozen radii below.

resolved_ambiguities.finding: The principal-angle comparison set and the provenance of U2, V2 and v after the range step were implicit.
resolved_ambiguities.resolution: Use the frozen (256-bit,radius-0.5) reference and compare the other three route decompositions to it, and retain the current-iterate J(x) bases through both steps. Recomputing a nullspace at x_range is forbidden.

resolved_ambiguities.finding: Read literally, sharing only ledger and semantic replay types would forbid the candidate and control from consuming the same frozen endpoint, oracle and counter schedule.
resolved_ambiguities.resolution: Frozen case data, the residual/target oracle, work-ledger type, semantic replay type and declared counter formula are common experimental inputs. Candidate and control share no Jacobian, Hessian, SVD, projected-operator, solve, convergence or error-estimation implementation helper.

resolved_ambiguities.finding: The analytic Hessian-direction callback had no explicit callback charge.
resolved_ambiguities.resolution: Every analytic Jacobian or analytic Hessian-direction invocation costs one callback; every C2 residual or target invocation costs one callback. Numeric derivative constructions receive no uncharged synthetic callback.

route_definition.rank_cutoff: tau_rank=32*n*eps(T)*max(1,sigma_1(J)) for the preregistered square systems
route_definition.rank_selection: With singular values in descending order, r is the smallest index 1<=r<n for which sigma_(r+1)/sigma_r<=1e-6 and sigma_r>tau_rank. No qualifying index, zero retained directions, or k=n-r>4 is typed unknown. Exactly the same r is required at 128 and 256 bits and radius multipliers 1 and 0.5. Equality with the gap bound passes; equality with tau_rank fails.
route_definition.principal_angle_definition: The reference is the decomposition at the same endpoint with (precision_bits=256,radius_multiplier=0.5). For two equal-dimensional orthonormal bases Qref and Q, sin(theta_max)=sqrt(max(0,1-sigma_min(Qref'*Q)^2)). The maximum left-nullspace value and maximum right-nullspace value over the other three route probes must each be <=1e-6.
route_definition.route_residual_goal: semantic_residual_tolerance/(4*error_reserve_multiplier), equal to 1.5625e-14 under the frozen controls
route_definition.fail_closed_route: Any nonfinite singular value, zero retained boundary value, dimension disagreement or absence of a qualifying smallest index fails closed.
route_definition.final_null_decay_gate: At the final audit, normalized_discarded_sigma=max(sigma_(r+1),...,sigma_n)/max(1,sigma_1) and normalized_last_step=norm(x_final-x_previous,Inf)/max(1,norm(x_final,Inf)). At both precisions and both Jacobian radii require normalized_discarded_sigma<=16*(normalized_last_step^2+eps(T)^(2/3)). This fail-closed applicability check prevents a regular close root with a persistent small singular value from being presented as S4 evidence; it is not a proof of multiplicity or isolation. Persist both normalized quantities, the bound and the Boolean decision for every probe.
route_definition.final_residual_decay_gate: For every primary and confirmation endpoint, re-evaluate at both 128 and 256 bits. Let x_route be that trajectory's frozen start, use the candidate radius-1 J(x_route) or the control's analytic J(x_route), and define F_scale=max(1,norm(F(x_route),Inf),norm(J(x_route),Inf)*max(1,norm(x_route,Inf))). Let r_norm=norm(F(x_final),Inf)/F_scale and s_norm=norm(x_final-x_previous,Inf)/max(1,norm(x_final,Inf)). Require r_norm<=16*(s_norm^2+eps(T)^(2/3)) at both precisions. Persist precision, F_scale, r_norm, s_norm, bound and decision. This rejects a stationary midpoint or inconsistent nonroot whose final step and discarded singular value vanish while a small nonzero residual remains; it is an applicability check, not an existence or isolation proof.

two_step_definition.frozen_nullity: The eligible endpoint route fixes k for the complete primary and confirmation run. At an outer iteration, the trailing k singular vectors and leading r=n-k retained vectors of the charged J(x) are used; k is not redetected or retuned from the iterate. Every iteration nevertheless requires finite singular values, sigma_r>tau_rank, and an m=1 projected B with full rank k and condition<=1e12.
two_step_definition.basis_lifetime: Compute J(x)=U*Sigma*V'. Form x_range with U1,Sigma1,V1. The U2,V2 below and v=V2*c are from this same J(x). They remain unchanged while evaluating J(x_range), B and the null step. No SVD or basis replacement at x_range is permitted.
two_step_definition.counter_coefficients: Use the fixed namespace 0x53342d43322d5631. For one-based null coordinate j and one-based trajectory-local iteration ell, initialize z=namespace xor (UInt64(k)<<48) xor (UInt64(ell)<<16) xor UInt64(j), then apply SplitMix64 exactly: z+=0x9e3779b97f4a7c15; z=(z xor (z>>30))*0xbf58476d1ce4e5b9; z=(z xor (z>>27))*0x94d049bb133111eb; u=z xor (z>>31). Set magnitude=1+Int(u & 0x7fffffff), sign=+1 when bit 63 is zero and -1 otherwise, a_j=sign*magnitude, and c=T.(a)/norm(T.(a),2). Precision, representation, case/family/Gold identity and confirmation index are not inputs. Persist ell, c and v in every iteration trace. Candidate and control duplicate this formula rather than share a helper.
two_step_definition.audit_counter_reservations: The initial projected-B step-safety audit uses ell=1. Every actual trajectory uses its one-based local iteration ell in 1:64. For every primary and confirmation trajectory, both the order-persistence audit at its frozen start and every final unapplied q/B audit use the reserved ell=65=maximum_global_iterations+1, independently of how many iterations the trajectory used; start/final, precision and radius audits therefore use the same coefficient vector for a fixed k. Audits charge callbacks and factorizations but do not consume a trajectory iteration.
two_step_definition.range_step: Solve Sigma1*y=U1'*F(x), then x_range=x-V1*y; no explicit inverse and no normal equations.
two_step_definition.mixed_direction_step: Let rho=m*eps(T)^(1/4)*max(1,norm(x_range,Inf)). For v use h=rho/max(norm(v,Inf),sqrt(eps(T))); for V2[:,j] use k_j=rho/max(norm(V2[:,j],Inf),sqrt(eps(T))). The candidate uses m=1 inside each trajectory iteration and uses m in {1,0.5} for initial-route and final audits.
two_step_definition.mixed_direction_stencil: D2F(x_range)[a,b] is estimated as (F(x+h*a+kappa*b)-F(x+h*a-kappa*b)-F(x-h*a+kappa*b)+F(x-h*a-kappa*b))/(4*h*kappa). Each corner is a separately charged canonical residual call.
two_step_definition.projected_operator: B[:,j]=U2'*D2F(x_range)[v,V2[:,j]]. The candidate uses m=1 to supply each trajectory step. Initial-route and final audits require the m=1 and m=0.5 operators to agree on full rank and the frozen condition gate. The analytic control has no finite-difference radius and obtains B from its independent analytic second-directional callback.
two_step_definition.projected_rank_cutoff: tau_B=32*k*eps(T)^(1/2)*max(1,sigma_1(B)). Both radius operators must have exactly k singular values strictly above tau_B and condition number <=1e12. Otherwise the trajectory is typed unknown.
two_step_definition.projected_order_persistence_gate: For every primary and confirmation trajectory, compute B_order_start at its frozen route start and B_order_final at its final endpoint with the same reserved ell=65 coefficient vector. The candidate computes both at p in {128,256}, m in {1,0.5}; the analytic control computes both at p in {128,256} with no radius. Sort each B spectrum descending. Start and final must both have dimension k, all k singular values strictly above their own tau_B, and condition<=1e12. For every i, ratio_i=sigma_i(B_order_final)/sigma_i(B_order_start) must be finite and lie in [1/16,16], with equality passing. A zero value, nonfinite value or dimension drift is typed unknown. Persist start/final spectra, both tau_B values, all ratios and decisions. All probes and factorizations are charged. This is a family/id/Gold-blind observation of the deflation-one limiting operator's nonzero order, not a proof of deflation depth.
two_step_definition.null_step: Evaluate a charged radius-1 C2 J(x_range), solve B*delta=-U2'*J(x_range)*v without an explicit inverse, and set x_next=x_range+V2*delta.
two_step_definition.step_policy: Apply the complete range step followed by the complete null step with unit step length. Damping, line search, trust clipping, component clipping, projection, fallback and partial-step acceptance are forbidden.
two_step_definition.stop_rule: A trajectory cannot converge before at least one complete two-step iteration. Thereafter it stops only when residual_linf<=1.5625e-14 and normalized_last_step=norm(x_next-x,Inf)/max(1,norm(x_next,Inf))<=configuration_error_goal/(4*error_reserve_multiplier)=1.5625e-12.
two_step_definition.failed_probe: An outer iteration is charged before its first oracle call. Any later residual/target callback domain or guard failure, nonfinite value, factorization, retained-value, projected-rank, condition, callback, iteration or deadline failure consumes all work already incurred and returns typed unknown. The frozen S4 split declares no finite configuration bounds, and no bound gate is claimed.

error_and_promotion_definition.final_audit_corrections: At x_final, q_(p,m) is the complete but unapplied two-step correction recomputed at precision p in {128,256} with Jacobian radius m and mixed-direction multiplier m in {1,0.5}; each q uses U2,V2,v from its own pre-range J(x_final). All audit oracle work is charged.
error_and_promotion_definition.configuration_fd_reserve: Let s_p=eps(T_p)^(2/3)*max(1,norm(x_p,Inf)). R_x_fd=max(max_p(norm(q_(p,1)-q_(p,0.5),Inf)+s_p), max_m(norm(q_(256,m)-q_(128,m),Inf)+max(s_128,s_256))). Values are compared after conversion to the 256-bit arithmetic used by the final artifact.
error_and_promotion_definition.analytic_configuration_reserve: The analytic control has one audit correction q_p per precision and no radius. It uses R_x_analytic=norm(q_256-q_128,Inf)+max(s_128,s_256), with the same s_p definition; inventing radius replicas is forbidden.
error_and_promotion_definition.raw_configuration_error: For the candidate, raw_x=max(last_step_128,last_step_256,norm(x_256-x_128,Inf),maximum pairwise Inf-norm disagreement among x_256 and all confirmation endpoints,R_x_fd). For the analytic control replace R_x_fd by R_x_analytic. last_step_p is the absolute Inf-norm of the final accepted complete two-step at precision p.
error_and_promotion_definition.target_gradient_audit: Compute charged central target gradients g_(p,m) at x_p using coordinate step h_j=m*eps(T_p)^(1/3)*max(1,abs(x_p[j])) for p in {128,256}, m in {1,0.5}. Let u_(p,m)=eps(T_p)^(2/3)*max(1,norm(g_(p,m),1)). R_g=max(max_p(norm(g_(p,1)-g_(p,0.5),1)+max(u_(p,1),u_(p,0.5))), max_m(norm(g_(256,m)-g_(128,m),1)+max(u_(128,m),u_(256,m)))). Use g_t=g_(256,1).
error_and_promotion_definition.target_error: Let target_roundoff=max_p(eps(T_p)*max(1,abs(t_p))). E_t=16*max(abs(t_256-t_128),maximum pairwise absolute disagreement among t_256 and all confirmation targets,norm(g_t,1)*raw_x,R_g*raw_x,target_roundoff). Promotion requires E_t<=1e-12.
error_and_promotion_definition.promotion: Promotion requires E_x<=1e-10, E_t<=1e-12, every primary and confirmation stop rule, every canonical semantic replay, the initial and final route/subspace/projected-operator gates, every projected-order-persistence, final null-decay and residual-decay gate, all residual/target callback domain and guard checks, and no budget/deadline failure. The split has no finite configuration bounds. Any missing diagnostic is typed unknown.

variant_route_probes.candidate: four charged finite-difference route probes: precision 128 and 256 crossed with Jacobian radius multipliers 1 and 0.5
variant_route_probes.analytic_control: two independently coded charged analytic-Jacobian probes at precision 128 and 256; there is no analytic radius. The 256-bit analytic nullspaces are the angle reference, and the same deterministic smallest qualifying r, retained-value, final null-decay and condition boundaries apply where defined.
variant_route_probes.projected_operator: The candidate audits mixed multipliers 1 and 0.5 initially and finally and uses multiplier 1 in trajectory steps. The analytic control invokes analytic_second_directional and has no finite-difference radius.

work_ledger.scope: one variant on one endpoint, shared by route probes, both primary precisions, all confirmations, final audits, convergence diagnostics, target-gradient/error work and canonical semantic replay
work_ledger.numeric_jacobian_charge: 2*n residual callbacks per central Jacobian; there is no additional Jacobian callback
work_ledger.numeric_projected_column_charge: 4 residual callbacks per mixed-direction column per radius
work_ledger.analytic_hessian_direction_charge: one residual-vector callback per direction pair; the returned vector must have residual_dimension entries and every entry must be finite, otherwise fail closed after charging

shared: frozen endpoint and Gold-hidden residual/target input
frozen trajectory starts and coefficient formula
work-ledger and canonical semantic replay types
artifact field names and final advancement predicates
must_be_separately_coded: rank rule, SVD split and principal-angle diagnostics
projected-B assembly, range solve and null solve
independent_control_boundary.candidate_visibility: The candidate receives CandidateInput only and cannot receive the analytic Hessian-direction control object.

freeze_order: Commit this amendment and an input-only generator while no S4 candidate/control implementation exists.
After the host-exclusive performance run ends, execute static/input tests and materialize s4-development-input-manifest.json.
Commit the immutable manifest and s4-input-freeze.json, including source, card and amendment hashes.
Only from the committed input-freeze parent may candidate and analytic-control implementation begin.
Freeze implementation and applicability hashes before the first development outcome.
Do not materialize locked inputs unless the unchanged development gate passes.
